hooks.name: Method citation check
hooks.description: Keeps study numbers and their citations consistent between the engine and the method document.

action.prompt: A file with Sootsayer's study constants was just saved (engine/src/method.rs or docs/METHOD.md). Check, without editing anything: (1) every numeric constant in engine/src/method.rs has a citation in its comment (study, table, or source); (2) docs/METHOD.md shows the same relative-risk table, thresholds, and default baselines as method.rs, value for value; (3) every interval satisfies low <= point <= high and the point is within 3% of sqrt(low*high); (4) any deviation from the paper (such as the 74.4% vs 1.774 note) is explained in both files. Reply with one line "PASS" or a short list of mismatches with file and value.
